statements.notes: 3 products in 1 pack
GNC AMP Men's Strength Vitapak Program delivers the power of three science-based formulas to help you achieve your daily nutritional goals as you build muscles and get stronger.

Increase strength & fuel your muscles 189% more efficiently
Because Creatine HCL 189 is clinically shown to be absorbed into your muscles 189% more efficiently than creatine monohydrate, you can increase strength & performance with 1/4 of the dose
If it’s on our packages, then it’s in our boxes. Clinically studied ingredients backed by real science. Get vitamins. Fuel muscles. Get stronger.
Move 9.5x more weight

In a randomized, double-blind, clinical study of 57 healthy, young adult males, subjects who took GNC AMP Creatine HCI 189 containing only 1.25 grams of the PEG-Creatine System significantly improved leg press 1-RM performance by 54.3 pounds, while subjects receiving 5 grams of creatine monohydrate significantly improved performance by 52.3 pounds and the placebo group showed no significant improvement at 5.7 pounds at the end of the study.
Increases strength & fuels your muscles 189% more efficiently
Dietary Supplement
Directions: As a dietary supplement, take the contents of one pack daily with food. Consume ample amounts of water while taking this product.
Warning: Consume ample amounts of water while taking this product.
